summary: Sample bundle for the --check tests: the findings are illustrative, drawn from the committed Luna evidence.
The Luna run ended blocked after 19.3 h: 39 visits, 41 Improve passes, 13 refused commands.
Three of the refusals were a space typed into a long path; eight share one message whose cause is not shown yet.
The main thread reached 97.5% of its context window with 34 compactions.
Next: print the run directory as a short alias, and say how the spec reads a long run's context.

basis.P2: Nine Improve children ran 41 passes and every child has a receipt.

f-refusals.title: 13 ShipLoop commands were refused on the Luna run
f-refusals.expected: The model runs the printed command exactly: no refused command.
f-refusals.observed: 13 refused commands (measured): 3 carry a space typed into a long path, 8 are the 'read the current packet' refusal and 2 are something else.
f-refusals.advice: Fix the 3 broken paths first: they are the only refusals with a clear cause. Inferred: the 8 packet refusals share one cause, which a read of the failures would show.

f-context.title: The Luna main thread peaked at 97.5% of its context window
f-context.expected: The run keeps its place across compactions (S-6) and its packet heads stay small (S-7).
f-context.observed: Main thread: 2,565 calls, peak 251,867 tokens of a 258,400-token window, 34 compactions. The numbers do not show whether the run lost its place.
f-context.advice: The spec does not say how to read a high peak. Inferred: a compaction is a defect only when the run loses its place, so the spec should say that.

a-callback-alias.title: Print the run directory as a short alias
a-callback-alias.goal: Do: print each completion call with the run directory as a short alias that the packet defines once, so a model never re-types a path of more than 100 characters. Files and symbols: `_callback` in skills/shiploop/scripts/shiploop_navigator.py. Test: a contract test in test/shiploop-navigator-contract.test.py that no printed completion call carries a path over 60 characters. Done when: that test passes and the next Luna-class run shows no refused call with a broken path (S-2, S-4).
a-callback-alias.why: For: 3 of the 13 refusals were a space typed into a long path, and the alias removes the cause. Against: one more line in every packet. Verdict: worth it for an S-sized change; measure the refusal count on the next run.

a-accept-paths.title: Accept the broken paths as a known limit
a-accept-paths.goal: Do: record in test/shiploop_e2e/LEARNINGS.md that 3 of 13 refusals on the Luna run were a stray space in a long path, each recovered in one turn, and change no code. Files and symbols: test/shiploop_e2e/LEARNINGS.md. Test: none; this records a known limit. Done when: the entry names the 3 refused calls and the evidence file.
a-accept-paths.why: A normal run with a short run path does not hit it: the paths here were over 100 characters.

a-spec-context.title: Say how the spec reads a long run's context

change.to: S-7: a long run's context peak and compactions are reported per host and read together; a compaction is a defect only when the run loses its place (S-6).
change.reason: Luna reached 97.5% of its window with 34 compactions, and the numbers alone cannot say whether the run lost its place.

a-spec-context.goal: Do: amend S-7 in test/shiploop_e2e/SPEC.md, in its own commit, to read context the way the change says. Files and symbols: S-7 in test/shiploop_e2e/SPEC.md and its row in the harness table. Test: read the clause back against metrics.json compactions and contextPeak. Done when: S-7 states when a high peak or a compaction is a defect and the harness table row agrees.
